metadata.title: chore: remove duplicate retry_with_backoff tests moved to cpex-plugins
metadata.author: msureshkumar88

description:
## Summary

Removes 38 integration and unit tests from `tests/unit/plugins/test_retry_with_backoff.py` that were transferred to or duplicated in the cpex-plugins repository (PR IBM/cpex-plugins#42) to establish single source of truth for plugin testing.

## Changes

- Removed 38 duplicate test methods across 8 test classes (266 lines)
- Retained 19 unique tests for framework integration testing
- Tests now maintained in single source of truth: `cpex-plugins/plugins/rust/python-package/retry_with_backoff/tests/`

## Tests Removed (38 total)

### Complete Class Removals
- **TestComputeDelayMs**: All 4 tests (delay calculation logic)
- **TestCfgFor**: All 3 tests (config override handling)
- **TestExecutionPathSelection**: All 3 tests (Rust vs Python execution paths)

### Partial Class Removals
- **TestIsFailure**: 8 of 16 tests (basic failure detection)
- **TestPluginInit**: 3 of 5 tests (initialization and clamping)
- **TestToolPostInvoke**: 5 of 9 tests (core retry behavior)
- **TestGetState**: 3 of 4 tests (state management)
- **TestRetryPolicyMetadata**: 2 of 4 tests (metadata attachment)

## Tests Retained (19 total)

Framework integration tests unique to mcp-context-forge:
- **TestIsFailure**: 8 tests for text content parsing edge cases
- **TestPluginInit**: 2 tests for clamping boundary conditions
- **TestToolPostInvoke**: 4 tests for retry flow variations
- **TestGetState**: 1 test for TTL preservation behavior
- **TestRetryPolicyMetadata**: 2 tests for success/exhaustion metadata paths

## Impact

- ✅ Eliminates 38 duplicate tests (266 lines removed)
- ✅ Maintains test coverage (tests exist in cpex-plugins)
- ✅ Reduces maintenance burden significantly
- ✅ Establishes single source of truth for plugin testing
- ✅ Retains 19 unique framework integration tests

## Testing

All remaining 19 tests in `test_retry_with_backoff.py` continue to pass. The removed 38 tests are now maintained and executed in the cpex-plugins repository.

Closes #4373

## Related

- IBM/cpex-plugins#42 - Original PR that established plugin test suite and moved tests

chore: remove 2 additional duplicate retry tests (404/401 non-retriable)

Remove test_is_error_with_404_skips_retry and test_is_error_with_401_skips_retry
